children: , the consumer-device and chip designer, is making a case for running demanding AI models on Macs instead of paying cloud providers for every use. Shares climbed to $337.48 around 11:11 a.m. ET Friday, up about 0.46% from Thursday's close.

The hardware makes that pitch harder to dismiss. Apple says its M5 Ultra Mac Studio supports up to 512 gigabytes of unified memory and 1.2 terabytes per second of memory bandwidth, while the M6 Mac mini starts at $899. In a demonstration reported by Reuters, four Mac Studios ran a trillion-parameter model using one wall outlet. That is an eye-catching display of capacity, though businesses still need to know what the machines cost to buy and run at scale.

The chart adds a valuation check: Apple's $337.48 share price sits 17.62% above its $286.93 GF Value. Local AI could give customers a reason to buy more powerful Macs, especially for steady workloads where cloud usage bills pile up. Investors are already paying a premium, however. Apple now has to turn a convincing demonstration into repeatable sales.

title: Apple Stock Gains as Macs Attack the Token Meter
